entries.subject: Placement
entries.finding: Gaia DR3 source 6253186686054822784: position at J2016.0. Distance: Gaia DR3 parallax 14.7719 +/- 0.0188 mas (same row, RUWE 0.93): 67.70 pc, no zero-point correction. Proper motion: Gaia DR3 (same row): -20.031, -30.963 mas/yr. Radial velocity from the same row.

entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 0.71 +/- 0.01 solar radii from Barragán et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of K2-233 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.522.3458B/abstract). Mass 0.79 +/- 0.01 solar masses from Barragán et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of K2-233 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023MNRAS.522.3458B/abstract). Temperature 4796 +/- 66 K from Barragán et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of K2-233 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Colour
entries.finding: A Planck spectrum at 4,796 K, because no archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), through the CIE 1931 2-degree observer: #ffe3c8. Routes tried in order: stis-ngsl: no HD number in SIMBAD; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number; planck: used.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 4,796 K and log g 4.63 (u1 0.713, u2 0.072): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
